I've already ruled out Zn+2 because it dissolves in excess NH3. So the only white hydroxide from group 3 is Al(OH)3.

All other group 3 cations form colored hydroxides, and since I observed a white precipitate with no color, they are not present.

Therefore, from the third analytical group, only Al+3 is present.
